name: druid
lore:
Druids are the guardians of the natural world, conduits of primal magic, and keepers of ancient secrets. They are the voice of the wild, the whisper of the wind through the trees, and the roar of the storm. Druids do not seek to dominate nature, but rather to be an extension of its will, a part of the intricate web of life that connects all things. They see the world as a delicate balance of elements, a cycle of life and death, and they strive to maintain this balance, protecting the wilderness from those who would seek to exploit or corrupt it.

To walk the path of the druid is to embrace the wild within, to attune oneself to the rhythms of the natural world. It is to learn the language of the animals, the secrets of the plants, and the wisdom of the earth. Druids often dwell in secluded groves or hidden glades, far from the trappings of civilization, where they can commune with nature and draw upon its power. They are protectors of the forests, shepherds of the mountains, and guardians of the sacred places where the veil between worlds is thin.

Druids are more than just spellcasters; they are the living embodiment of the wild. Through their deep connection to nature, they can shapeshift into the forms of beasts, command the elements, and heal the wounds of the land. They are the defenders of the wilderness, the champions of the natural world, and the keepers of its ancient lore.
